content_data.email_purpose: Proposal for implementing FHIR-compliant API architecture to improve patient data interoperability and system integration capabilities.
key_points: FHIR R4 standard implementation will enable seamless data exchange with external healthcare systems and meet regulatory requirements
Security enhancements include OAuth 2.0 implementation and end-to-end encryption for PHI data
content_data.call_to_action: Please review the technical proposal and provide feedback within the next 10 days so we can schedule an architecture review meeting and finalize the implementation roadmap.
